title: DynamoDBBatchRecommendationsContract
description: JSON schema for Amazon DynamoDB user_recommendations table items

generatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp (seconds) when batch recommendations were computed

ttlTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp (seconds) when DynamoDB automatically purges the item (TTL)

recommendations.description: Ordered array of Top-50 precomputed batch recommendations

rank.description: Rank position in batch candidate generation

modelId.description: Version identifier of the batch collaborative filtering model
